text: What if you tried to lift a million dollars?
Start with one hundred-dollar bill. One gram.
Ten thousand of them make a million.
That's just ten kilos. Like a big watermelon.
It fits in one big briefcase.
Easy! Now switch to one-dollar bills.
A million singles weigh about a ton.
As heavy as a small car.
Stack them up... over a hundred meters tall.
Taller than the Statue of Liberty.
Laid end to end, they'd stretch 156 kilometers.
Two hundred fifty tons of metal.
About as heavy as two blue whales.
You'd need a dozen big trucks.
So... which million would you carry home?
